description: Resolve the exact GO term names and identifiers relevant to the BT_0674 curation decision: the five terms currently on Q8A9Z1, plus candidate replacement terms found by searching the GO ontology for carboxynorspermidine, carboxyspermidine and spermidine biosynthesis. Build the figure from the actually computed annotation audit and the iteration-2 structural measurements.
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
H = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0", "Accept": "application/json"}

def term(ids):
    u = "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/ontology/go/terms/" + ",".join(ids)
    r = requests.get(u, headers=H, timeout=60)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        print("term lookup failed", r.status_code); return {}
    return {t["id"]: (t.get("name"), t.get("aspect")) for t in r.json().get("results", [])}

cur = ["GO:0009085", "GO:0045312", "GO:0003824", "GO:0008836", "GO:0016831"]
print("=== terms currently on Q8A9Z1 ===")
tn = term(cur)
for g in cur:
    print("%-12s %-20s %s" % (g, tn.get(g, ("?", "?"))[1], tn.get(g, ("?", "?"))[0]))

print("\n=== ontology search for candidate replacement terms ===")
for q in ["carboxynorspermidine", "carboxyspermidine", "spermidine biosynthetic",
          "pyridoxal phosphate binding"]:
    u = ("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/ontology/go/search?query=%s&limit=12"
         % q.replace(" ", "%20"))
    r = requests.get(u, headers=H, timeout=60)
    print("\n-- %s (HTTP %d)" % (q, r.status_code))
    if r.status_code != 200:
        continue
    for t in r.json().get("results", []):
        if t.get("isObsolete"):
            continue
        print("   %-12s %-20s %s" % (t["id"], t.get("aspect"), t.get("name")))

# ---------------- figure: computed evidence behind the curation call ----------------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.5, 4.4))

# panel A: GO evidence audit (counts from the QuickGO query above)
labels = ["BT_0674\nQ8A9Z1", "lysA BT_1374\nQ8A800", "CASDH BT_4612\nQ89YW9"]
iea = [3, 4]; iba = [2, 2]
iea.append(0); iba.append(0)
x = np.arange(3)
ax[0].bar(x, iea, 0.55, label="IEA", color="#9ecae1")
ax[0].bar(x, iba, 0.55, bottom=iea, label="IBA", color="#de2d26")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("GO annotation lines (QuickGO)")
ax[0].set_title("A. No experimental GO evidence on any of the three", fontsize=9)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8, title="evidence code", title_fontsize=8)
ax[0].text(0, 5.25, "GO:0008836 + GO:0009085\nIBA from PTN000159906", ha="center", fontsize=7.5, color="#de2d26")
ax[0].text(1, 6.25, "same IBA node,\nplus UniProt IEA", ha="center", fontsize=7.5)
ax[0].set_ylim(0, 8)

# panel B: transferred-product contact distances, 3N29 observed vs 36GY modelled
res = ["Lys42\n(Lys41)", "Cys174\n(Cys169)", "Ser242\n(Glu236)", "Asp279\n(Asp272)",
       "Leu310\n(Leu314)", "Tyr338\n(Tyr342)", "Lys342\n(Lys346)"]
obs = [2.56, 3.07, 2.54, 2.57, 3.36, 3.05, 3.57]       # 3N29 deposited complex
mod = [2.56, 2.73, 4.10, 2.62, 2.93, 3.36, 2.29]       # product transferred into 36GY frame
x = np.arange(len(res)); w = 0.38
ax[1].bar(x - w/2, obs, w, label="3N29 C. jejuni (deposited)", color="#636363")
ax[1].bar(x + w/2, mod, w, label="36GY B. fragilis (transferred)", color="#31a354")
ax[1].axhline(3.5, ls="--", lw=0.9, color="k")
ax[1].text(6.4, 3.58, "H-bond limit", fontsize=7, ha="right")
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(res, fontsize=7)
ax[1].set_ylabel("distance to norspermidine product (A)")
ax[1].set_title("B. One contact lost: Ser242 OG 4.10 A vs Glu236 OE1 2.54 A", fontsize=9)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=7.5)

# panel C: cavity volumes with the in-silico truncation control
names = ["3N29 holo\nGlu236", "3N29 holo\nGlu236->Ser\n(in silico)", "9EAF apo\nGlu240", "36GY apo\nSer242"]
vol = [246, 246, 305, 397]
cols = ["#636363", "#bdbdbd", "#3182bd", "#31a354"]
ax[2].bar(np.arange(4), vol, 0.6, color=cols)
for i, v in enumerate(vol):
    ax[2].text(i, v + 8, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_xticks(np.arange(4)); ax[2].set_xticklabels(names, fontsize=7)
ax[2].set_ylabel("buried cavity volume (A^3)")
ax[2].set_ylim(0, 460)
ax[2].set_title("C. Glu to Ser changes volume by 0 A^3; apo state does not", fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
